hypothesis: The strongest comparable NFI control still leaves some original entries unfunded because of its six-slot limit. Two additional slots can admit profitable trades without applying an eight-way divisor to the Top Coins first-stake policy.
treatment: Compose frozen NFIEightSlots and FlatTopBoost. Maximum slots rise from six to eight. Ask the native wallet for the six-slot proposal using actual current cash; apply the exact previously frozen 1.25 multiplier only where eligible. Native wallet/venue bounds, signals, position adjustment and exits are inherited. Original logic using actual free slots sees eight. No delayed exits from the rejected profit-tail composition.
comparison: Same official engine and complete 40-pair, 1000 USDT, isolated 1x account from 2025-01-01 UTC to 2026-08-31 23:00 UTC, with unchanged mark, funding and cost model. Primary control is FlatTopBoost at +161.8360% net return for the 15bp historical window. Report original and standalone eight-slot results under the same contract.
known_evidence: Fixed boost rejected 58 native slot-limited intent events in the 15bp simulation. Standalone eight slots added 10 independent entries and 5.7130 percentage points over plain NFI at 15bp but failed its own drawdown gate. Fixed boost plus delayed exits is rejected at 15bp. No combined eight-slot return was seen before freezing this trial.
advance: First require higher full marked net return than the fixed boost at 15bp and reconciled account economics. If it passes, run the same configuration at 8bp and evaluate both controls and the exact candidate in the 2026-11-05 through 2026-11-24 UTC window, whose coverage has been verified and whose economic outcome is unused by this study. Record concurrent exposure, hourly drawdown, trade counts and head-of-distribution outcomes in every account.
